message.content: {"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The Initial Approach pledges to \u201cEnsure all information comes directly from the document without inference,\u201d yet the memo includes inferential/subjective claims (e.g., \u201cdemonstrates continued institutional support,\u201d \u201cindicates cooperative lender relationship,\u201d \u201csignals potential execution challenges,\u201d \u201csuggests urgency\u201d), contradicting that commitment."]}
